pairs.locator: Abstract
pairs.quote: The initial temperature of MgH2 decomposition can be lowered from 322 °C for pristine MgH2 to 214 °C through the employment of Ti3CN. ‖ The employment of Ti3CN can significantly improve the hydrogen release kinetics of MgH2, with the desorption activation energy decreasing from 121 to 80 kJ mol−1. ‖ Regarding thermodynamics, the desorption enthalpy changes of MgH2 and MgH2 + 7.5 wt% Ti3CN were 79.3 and 78.8 kJ mol−1, respectively.
pairs.notes: Article uses the Arrhenius/JMA route (not Kissinger) for Ea; original wording kept in notes to avoid mislabelling. ΔH from van't Hoff PCT slopes.
